question: For weekly-sales data, I need an analysis of our sales performance around mid-June for the years 2018, 2019, and 2020. Specifically, calculate the percentage change in sales between the four weeks leading up to June 15 and the four weeks following June 15 for each year.
sql:
WITH weekly_totals AS (
    SELECT calendar_year, week_number, SUM(sales) as total_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
      AND week_number IN (21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26, 27, 28, 29)
    GROUP BY calendar_year, week_number
),
before_june AS (
    SELECT calendar_year, SUM(total_sales) as sales_before
    FROM weekly_totals
    WHERE week_number IN (21, 22, 23, 24)
    GROUP BY calendar_year
),
after_june AS (
    SELECT calendar_year, SUM(total_sales) as sales_after
    FROM weekly_totals
    WHERE week_number IN (26, 27, 28, 29)
    GROUP BY calendar_year
)
SELECT 
    b.calendar_year,
    b.sales_before,
    a.sales_after,
    ROUND((a.sales_after - b.sales_before) * 100.0 / b.sales_before, 2) as pct_change
FROM before_june b
JOIN after_june a ON b.calendar_year = a.calendar_year
ORDER BY b.calendar_year
